text: CULN 305 Culinary Health Credits: 4. 3 Lecture Hours. 3 Lab Hours. Overview: 3 Lecture Hours. 3 Lab Hours. Integration of nutrition science principles, dietary recommendations, and food and cooking skills to facilitate healthy eating behaviors for health promotion; application to recipe development and modification to meet specific dietary needs and sensory acceptability. Prerequisites: NUTR 301 ; enrollment in culinary health certificate program; junior or senior classification. text: CULN 483 Culinary Health Practicum Credits: 2. 5 Lab Hours. Overview: 5 Lab Hours.
